title.zh: 增长还在，但两条下调条件已经触发
title.en: Growth continues, but two downgrade conditions have fired

change.zh: 本次补入 Q3 财报后，研究重点转向增长的质量：收入同比增长 49%，同时毛利率降至 57%，订阅用户环比减少。全年调整后 EBITDA 指引也被下调。
change.en: The Q3 update shifts attention to the quality of growth: revenue rose 49% year over year, while gross margin fell to 57% and subscribers declined sequentially. Full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance was also lowered.

meaning.zh: 毛利率与订阅变化分别命中此前写下的下调条件。新事实已补入报告，但尚未据此完成估值与立场重裁；已发布的谨慎、低确信仍属于旧裁定。
meaning.en: Margin and subscriber performance each meet a previously published downgrade condition. The facts are in the report, but valuation and stance have not yet been re-adjudicated; cautious / low conviction remains the historical ruling.

next.zh: 单独复核新盈利指引与用户趋势对估值的影响，完成立场重裁。
next.en: Review the valuation implications of lower profit guidance and subscriber trends, then re-adjudicate the stance.

title.zh: 交付表现达到上行复核条件，现金转化仍待验证
title.en: Delivery clears the upside review threshold; cash conversion still needs proof

change.zh: Q3 收入和毛利率同时超过报告预设的上行复核门槛。单季经营现金流转正，在手订单扩大；但扣除资本开支后，单季现金流仍为负。
change.en: Q3 revenue and gross margin both exceeded the report’s thresholds for an upside review. Quarterly operating cash flow turned positive and backlog grew, but cash flow after capital spending remained negative.

meaning.zh: 本次更新提供了重建上行情景的依据，还没有形成新的估值结论。Neutron 首飞仍以不早于 2027 年为目标，与此前披露一致，不应写成又一次延期。
meaning.en: The update provides grounds to rebuild the upside scenario, without establishing a new valuation conclusion. Neutron still targets no earlier than 2027, consistent with prior disclosure rather than another delay.

next.zh: 重建上行情景，并用完整下半年数据检验现金与订单质量。
next.en: Rebuild the upside scenario and use full second-half results to assess cash generation and backlog quality.

title.zh: 资产出售改变了下一轮估值需要回答的问题
title.en: The planned asset sale changes the questions for the next valuation review

change.zh: 报告补入 Q3 业绩、首次发布的 2027 年指引，以及以 40 亿美元出售 4.9GW 燃气电厂的计划。公司同时披露回购与交割后减债安排。
change.en: The report adds Q3 results, initial 2027 guidance and a plan to sell 4.9GW of gas plants for $4 billion, alongside buyback and post-closing debt-reduction plans.

meaning.zh: 后续估值需要同时考虑售出资产的盈利贡献、出售所得与资本分配。交易目标为 2027 年第二季度交割且仍待审批；已公布的 2027 年指引尚未计入此次出售。
meaning.en: The next valuation must consider earnings leaving with the assets, sale proceeds and capital allocation together. Closing is targeted for Q2 2027 and remains subject to approvals; published 2027 guidance excludes the sale.

next.zh: 核实审批与交割进展，并在独立估值复核中重算出售后的盈利和债务。
next.en: Track approvals and closing, then rebuild post-sale earnings and debt in a separate valuation review.

title.zh: 盈利指引收窄，收购与融资承诺仍有待落地
title.en: Earnings guidance narrows while acquisition and financing remain conditional

change.zh: 本次补入 Q3 业绩、收窄后的全年盈利指引，以及拟收购 RISEC 的进展。报告同时更新债务事实与 DOE 担保的条件边界。
change.en: This update adds Q3 results, a narrower full-year earnings range and the proposed RISEC acquisition, together with debt facts and the conditions attached to the DOE guarantee.

meaning.zh: 拟议收购仍待批准，DOE 至多 50 亿美元担保也只是有条件承诺。两者都不能直接当作已完成交易或已到位资金计入新的估值结论。
meaning.en: The acquisition still awaits approval and the DOE guarantee of up to $5 billion is a conditional commitment. Neither establishes a completed transaction or funding already received for a new valuation conclusion.

next.zh: 跟踪交易审批与融资条件，并在估值重算时统一处理债务及新指引。
next.en: Track approvals and financing conditions, then reconcile debt and new guidance in a valuation rebuild.

title.zh: 重新估值后，从谨慎调整为中性观察
title.en: A rebuilt valuation moves the stance from cautious to neutral-watch

change.zh: 按 10 月 30 日收盘价重建估值，并纳入 Q3 业绩、Q4 指引及通美私募影响。立场由谨慎、中确信调整为中性观察、低确信。
change.en: Valuation was rebuilt at the October 30 close using Q3 results, Q4 guidance and the Tongmei placement. The stance moves from cautious / medium to neutral-watch / low conviction.

meaning.zh: 这次调整来自价格与情景分布的变化，并非此前的上调条件已经触发。重建后的牛熊分布大致对称，加权年化回报仍低于要求门槛，因此没有转为偏多。
meaning.en: The change is driven by price and the scenario distribution, rather than a previously published upgrade condition firing. Bull and bear outcomes are roughly symmetric, while the weighted annualized return remains below the hurdle, so the stance does not become constructive.

next.zh: 继续核实 Q3 10-Q、出口许可与私募交割条件；相关未知项仍限制确信度。
next.en: Verify the Q3 10-Q, export permits and placement closing conditions; unresolved items continue to limit conviction.
